text: 东北证券宏观首席分析师廖博在2026上海总量观澜论坛上表示，近期市场波动主要表现为流动性再平衡，流动性或成为大类资产定价主线，股市表现有望向内涵价值收敛，前期调整较多的科创板、创业板有望实现估值修复；全球市场将在流动性波动环境中震荡运行，基本面和企业盈利韧性决定后续表现的斜率与可持续性。产业层面，AI算力、先进存储等需求带动硬科技链量价齐升，以AI、机器人、创新药为代表的新质生产力企业业绩延续高增，完备制造业体系与产品性价比红利正转化为出口出海型企业的全球竞争优势。配置上可概括为“科技为矛、商品为盾”，2027年出口仍是中国经济的结构性亮点。(人民财讯)
text_en: Liao Bo, chief macro analyst at Northeast Securities, said at the 2026 Shanghai Macro Outlook Forum that recent market volatility is mainly a liquidity rebalancing, and liquidity may become the main thread of large asset class pricing; stock market performance is expected to converge toward intrinsic value, and the STAR Market and ChiNext, which saw larger corrections earlier, are expected to achieve valuation repair; global markets will fluctuate in a liquidity-volatile environment, and fundamentals and corporate earnings resilience will determine the slope and sustainability of subsequent performance. At the industry level, demand for AI computing power and advanced storage is driving both volume and price increases across the hard-tech chain, and the performance of new quality productive forces companies represented by AI, robotics and innovative drugs continues to grow rapidly; the dividend from a complete manufacturing system and product cost-effectiveness is being transformed into the global competitive advantage of export-oriented enterprises. In terms of allocation, this can be summarized as "technology as the spear, commodities as the shield"; in 2027, exports will remain a structural highlight of China's economy. (People's Caixin)
